purpose: Find independent pressure/sinkage constraints without changing the frozen TREC campaign

sources.title: Simulated Lunar Environment For The Study Of Regolith Strength: An Improved Vacuum Bevameter Design
sources.inspection: Original 18-page PDF text inspected. Preliminary plate tests use air-dried JSC-1A in ambient Earth conditions, with a 32 mm plate; the reported limitations include shaft friction, a single density and room temperature.
sources.decision: Do not substitute these measurements for GRC-3 or flight-site lunar material. No numbers entered the frozen campaign or active app model.

sources.inspection: The retained paper describes GRC-3 density/friction-angle sets and cautions that Bekker/Janosi parameters require a bevameter and are gravity-dependent. These physical density/friction values do not independently determine SCM pressure/sinkage stiffness or shear length.
sources.decision: Keep pressure/sinkage coefficients explicitly assumed, fitted parameters non-unique, and lunar validation false. Seek matched independent normal/shear tests and a separate validation campaign before mission use.
